subject: general
question: _____ on 9 September 2024 emphasised that safety and social audits of cities and institutions should be carried out to get a better idea about the lags and issues that currently exist in terms of ensuring women’s safety in India.

options.text: The All India Federation of Women Lawyers (AIFWL)

solution:
The correct answer is __**The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) of India is an autonomous public body constituted on 12 October 1993 under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
 
• NHRC emphasised the need for safety and social audits of cities and institutions to identify and address gaps in ensuring women's safety in India.
 
• It aims to protect and promote human rights, including the rights of women and marginalized communities.
 
• The NHRC has the power to investigate violations of human rights and recommend remedial measures to the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993**

 
 
• The Act provides for the creation of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), State Human Rights Commissions, and Human Rights Courts.
 
• It aims to protect and promote human rights guaranteed by the Constitution of India or embodied in international covenants.
 
 
 
• **Functions of NHRC**
 
 
• Inquire into complaints of human rights violations and negligence in the prevention of such violations by public servants.
 
• Review the safeguards provided by the Constitution or any law for the protection of human rights and recommend measures for their effective implementation.
 
• Spread human rights awareness among the public and promote research in the field of human rights.
 
 
 
• **Women's Safety in India**
 
 
• Ensuring women's safety involves addressing issues such as domestic violence, sexual harassment, and discrimination in various spheres of life.
 
• The government and various organizations implement laws, policies, and programs to protect women's rights and promote gender equality.
 
 
 
• **Social Audits**
 
 
• Social audits involve the evaluation of the performance of public services and schemes by the community and stakeholders.
 
• They aim to ensure transparency, accountability, and participation in governance.
